name: Point Engine for Scalar Fields
definition: A method to estimate foot points on an isosurface of a scalar field using a simplified version of Marching Cubes that finds only vertices without computing triangles, avoiding the expense of iterative refinement.
summary: Point Engine for Scalar Fields generates a flat list of surface points with gradients by extracting only vertices via simplified Marching Cubes, avoiding triangle computation and iterative refinement.
